title: Approximation algorithm for mixed volumes of a constant number of convex bodies
summary: We study the computation of mixed volumes of convex sets given as rational subspace sections of bodies described by membership oracles. The sets need not have nonempty interior. For positive multiplicities $α_1+\cdots+α_k=n$, we give a randomized algorithm that computes a relative $\varepsilon$-approximation with probability at least $1-δ$. Its running time is polynomial in Gurvits' factor $Γ_α=(n^n/n!)\prod_iα_i!/α_i^{α_i}$, the input presentation length, and $\varepsilon^{-1}$, and linear in $1+\logδ^{-1}$, with degree independent of $k$.
